findings.message: `GDRIVE_SECRET_ID = "gdrive_shared_folder_id"` (and the `get_shared_drive_id` task built on it) is copied verbatim into four system-test modules in this PR - here, example_gcs_to_sheets.py, example_sheets_to_gcs.py and example_sql_to_sheets.py. Define the secret id once in a shared test module and import it, so renaming the secret does not leave three of the four DAGs behind.
